text:
riley: hi all, started today but my Okta link bounced with "email alias mismatch" (riley@redwood.ai vs riley.jones@redwood.ai). 1Password won't let me finish provisioning and I can't see the onboarding drive. yubikey shipping is also delayed. who to ping for alias fix or a short-term workaround?
tara-peopleops: hey @riley 1 sorry about the alias. Looks like your Google account has an alternate address. I'm updating your Okta user to the primary alias now and reissuing the invite. If that doesn't work I'll swap the email on the seat. Will also add you to OnboardingReaders.
riley: thanks! curious if there's a passkey fallback for MFA until the yubikey arrives — i use macOS and can create a platform passkey.
tara-peopleops: we prefer yubikeys for hardware MFA but passkeys are acceptable temporarily. I'll mark your account as allowed for passkeys. After you finish Okta sign-in, enroll a passkey under Security -> Add passkey.
devops-bot: ticket #IN-3421 created for alias/Okta reprovision. Assigned to people-ops. ETA 20m.
nate-eng: for 1Password, seats are synced from People Ops. If `op signin` returns "account not provisioned" wait a few minutes after seat is added. If you need secrets sooner, I can create a temporary team vault share (will expire in 48h). Want that?
riley: yes please for the vault share, that would unblock onboarding scripts. also i need repo access before SSO is final. what's the fastest path?
nate-eng: fastest is SSH key added to your GitHub user (we can add you to the repo). DM me the public key. If you prefer a temporary PAT, we can create a time-limited token but SSH is cleaner.
tara-peopleops: ok email alias fixed and okta invite resent (subject: "Redwood Okta Invite"). you should also see the onboarding folder. let us know if the invite still errors.it-bot: automation: sent reissued invite to riley.jones@redwood.ai at 2481123368
riley: invite worked! signed in, enrolled passkey successfully. `op signin` still said not provisioned but after ~6m it accepted my login and 1Password shows the team vault.
nate-eng: added your SSH key and gave repo read access. try `git clone git@github.com:redwood/repo.git`
riley: clone succeeded. big thanks. yubikey ETA updated to 2 business days.
tara-peopleops: welcome again @riley 389 I'll DM the temporary vault link and the onboarding checklist. Ping this thread if anything else pops up.
it-bot: INC-3421 marked resolved by people-ops at 2481123401
